description: This file contains functions and logic for managing the configuration and JSON model files for the openclaw agent, including reading, writing, fingerprinting, and locking mechanisms.

methods.name: readFileMtimeMs
methods.description: Reads the modification time of a file in milliseconds, returns null if file does not exist or error occurs.

methods.name: stableStringify
methods.description: Serializes a value into a stable JSON string, ensuring consistent ordering for objects.

methods.name: buildModelsJsonFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for the models JSON based on config, secrets, and file mtimes.

methods.name: readExistingModelsFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the existing models.json file, returning raw content and parsed object.

methods.name: ensureModelsFileMode
methods.description: Sets file permissions to 600 for the models file, best-effort.

methods.name: writeModelsFileAtomic
methods.description: Writes contents to a file atomically using a temporary file and rename.

methods.name: resolveModelsConfigInput
methods.description: Resolves and projects the configuration input, returning config and secrets source.

methods.name: withModelsJsonWriteLock
methods.description: Ensures exclusive write access to the models JSON file using a lock mechanism.

methods.name: ensureOpenClawModelsJson
methods.description: Main function to ensure models.json exists and is up-to-date, with locking and fingerprinting.
